description: Brazil ANTT railway open geospatial data provides official files for Brazilian railway authorisation requests and railways awarded by authorisation. The provider is ANTT. Geographical and temporal coverage: The ANTT maps page identifies two downloadable collections updated in August 2024; payloads were not inspected. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-ND-3.0 (gov.br site-wide statement: all content of the site published under CC BY-ND 3.0 Unported). The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: This is an authorisations collection, not a complete operational Brazilian railway network. Internal archive formats are unknown. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to data-brazil-antt-open-data, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
